sentences.en: The grainy texture of these mashed potatoes is deeply unpleasant.
sentences.zh: 这些土豆泥颗粒状的质地让人感觉非常不舒服。

sentences.en: Many children are fussy about eating foods with certain textures.
sentences.zh: 很多孩子对某些口感的食物挑食。

sentences.en: Strawberry tree fruits have a kind of ice cream texture.
sentences.zh: 草莓树的果实有一种冰淇淋般的口感。
